createOrReplace.title: Admission Requirements International High School Students - U of T
createOrReplace.excerpt: GCE: five different IGCSE/GCSE/O Level academic subjects and three different A Level/International A Level academic subjects; English IGCSE/GCSE/O/AS/A Level required for all programs; Mathematics AS or A Level required for programs with the Calculus prerequisite. IB: International Baccalaureate Diploma, with English HL or SL; IB Math AA SL/HL or AI HL satisfy the Calculus prerequisite. US: High School Diploma from an accredited high school; competitive applicants enrolled in a rigorous academic course load. Calculus, AP Calculus (AB or BC) or one semester of college/university calculus is required for most math, science, computer science and commerce programs. Students who have written SAT or ACT tests may submit their scores. Applicants to Engineering are required to fully disclose all test scores.
